_readme: Single source of truth for the GPT-SoVITS engine requirements fixups used when
requirements-train.txt is generated. Two independent generators read this file:
- app/train.py (runtime self-heal before the training deps install)
Do not re-hardcode any of these lists in the generators: the two used to drift and
both pushed source-only packages at pip (pyopenjtalk build stop, jieba_fast has only
a tar.gz and its setup.py compiles a C extension unconditionally).
Reading rule for BOTH generators: one requirement per line; strip leading whitespace
before matching; dropPrefixes is a prefix match (not a glob), so 'onnxruntime' also
drops 'onnxruntime-gpu'. replacements match the package name at the start of the
line (name ends at the first char outside [A-Za-z0-9._-]; compare case-insensitively
with '-' and '_' treated as equal); a string value REPLACES the whole line, a null
value means the package is provided by the local shim directory and is NOT sent to
pip at all. shims lists the packages that exist under tts-pack/shims/ (already on the
training PYTHONPATH ahead of .pylibs) - they must never reach pip.
